profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Software Development, Agile Methodologies
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 13+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications and complex software solutions. Proficient in both front-end and back-end technologies, with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, performance-optimized applications. Expertise in leading Agile teams through the full software development lifecycle, ensuring rapid iteration, timely delivery, and alignment with business goals. Proven track record of mentoring cross-functional teams, collaborating effectively with clients, and driving system optimizations for enhanced performance and scalability. Passionate about solving complex technical challenges, modernizing legacy systems, and delivering innovative solutions that exceed user expectations.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- migration of web applications, databases, and ETL processes from on-premises/virtual servers to Google Cloud Platform (GCP), optimizing scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
- Developed and automated multiple ETL workflows, streamlining data integration and improving the efficiency and timeliness of reporting on Tableau dashboards.
- Diagnosed and resolved performance bottlenecks by optimizing code, databases, and infrastructure, ensuring high-performance, responsive, and scalable applications.
- Quickly developed and deployed several web applications and data processes during the COVID-19 pandemic, enabling the organization to efficiently monitor healthcare trends and support critical operations.
- Worked closely with clients to gather requirements, provide regular progress updates, and translate technical specifications into actionable business solutions that aligned with organizational goals.
positions.insights: Software Development, Cloud Storage and +13 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer/Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Project: Global User Authentication (GUA) – Single Sign-On Solution for a Leading U.S. Tax Preparation Company

GUA was developed to provide a secure single sign-on mechanism for multiple client applications. Acting as an authentication gateway, it ensures seamless access to protected resources while facilitating secure transfer of user attributes across consuming applications. This platform enhances data security and ensures continuous connectivity with end users year-round.

Roles and Responsibilities:
- Designed and developed key application workflows for GUA, enabling efficient single sign-on integration and secure authentication processes.
- Led daily Scrum calls and provided progress updates to the client, ensuring clear communication and alignment with project goals.
- Collaborated with clients to perform in-depth requirement analysis, gathering business needs and translating them into technical specifications.
- Coordinated WebEx meetings with onsite teams to review project status, address challenges, and discuss solutions.
- Prepared release notes and deployed builds to development servers, ensuring smooth transitions before each QA release.
- Mentored junior associates, onboarding them with project-specific knowledge and best practices to enhance team productivity.
- Updated project-related documents on the client’s internal university portal, ensuring accurate and timely documentation.
- Conducted code reviews with both the internal team and the client’s technical lead to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project : eMatrix - Various custom tailored versions for French automotive supplier company
- Developed TCL script for object export and batch script for FTP file download in eMatrix - OpenDXM project
- Tested application functionality to ensure proper operation
- Contributed to bug-fixing and customization in Engineering and Designer Centrals for eMatrix – Core R4.0.12 project
- Supported development of evolutions and defect fixing in the project
